# Dazzle Media Group

Premier sign board manufacturer and PR agency based in Bengaluru, India. Specialising in custom signage (LED, acrylic, ACP, office signage) and corporate PR services with 25+ years of expertise.

## Core Services

- LED & Neon Signage: Energy‑efficient, vibrant displays for retail and corporate use.
- Custom & Acrylic Letters: Precision‑cut letters for sophisticated storefronts.
- ACP & Outdoor Boards: Durable, weather‑resistant signage for high‑traffic areas.
- Office Signage Solutions: Glass films, reception branding, wayfinding systems.
- Flex Printing: High‑quality, rapid‑turnaround flex and vinyl printing.
- PR & Media Coverage: Startup PR, corporate PR, and global media network placements.
